alt: 大家興致勃勃地討論出遊計畫，神情雀躍、熱烈分享，滿心期待即將到來的活動。
scene_prompt: 興高采烈：現代原創成年親友圍著郊遊的無字自然路線圖與背包，滿臉興奮期待、互相熱烈分享建議，一人指小圖自然景點、其他人高興附和，興致很高且情緒熱烈。不是炫耀勝利得意忘形、亂跳危險高處或只有靜靜微笑。自然每人兩臂，不加多餘手，無文字、數字、品牌、真景點或已知地圖。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Where people appear, give each anatomically coherent bodies with exactly two arms and natural hands.
